annotations.title: Evidence pack for a paid x402 call that went wrong

description: For a paid x402 call that delivered nothing, the wrong thing, or charged more than listed, and you or your operator need evidence for the seller, a facilitator or a dispute. Pass service_url, network and tx (from PAYMENT-RESPONSE). alalanet reads the payment on chain and adds its own signed history of that service: listing, observed payTo and price, probes near the payment time, verified purchase reports and its own test purchase. Returns findings (counterparty_mismatch, offer_drift, service_unavailable_at_payment, delivery_nonconformance) with deltas, what was consistent, what could not be checked, and a signed hash of the whole pack (log kind 4309). The delivery finding uses an earlier report_purchase for this payment, if there is one.

network.description: Base: eip155:8453 or base; Solana: solana or solana:5eykt4UsFv8P8NJdTREpY1vzqKqZKvdp
